Subject: Demo recap + model-fit evidence (next steps)

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the clarity on your throughput targets and the conversational-quality constraints for triage workflows. Quick recap and the artifacts I promised below: 

Key points from our call:
- Target: 350–450 QPS equivalent (batched) for classification/triage with p99 latency target <= 120ms on inference path.
- Quality requirement: F1 >= 0.86 on the labeled triage set; hallucination tolerance low (must flag low-confidence outputs).
- Integration: data will flow from your event stream to a private Redwood Dedicated pool, with strict retention controls.

What we’re recommending next (short):
1) Run the short evaluation sweep we discussed against our verified candidate models (links below). This will validate TPS, cold-starts, and p99 latency under your prompt patterns.
2) Share the seed prompt set (attached) and a subset of the labeled triage examples so we can produce an initial SLO-proof snapshot.
3) Quick pilot: 2-week pilot on Dedicated (reserved small pool) to validate latency and quality with your exact traffic shape.

Attached: prompt_sets_v1.txt (seed prompts); perf_snapshot_20280520.csv (redwood verified snapshot — sample); slo_matrix_Cerebro.pdf (draft SLOs).

Redwood-verified profiles I referenced (summary links):
- rwd-m-3b-quant (recommended for mixed latency/throughput): 1.8k TPS (batched), median token latency 12ms, p95 68ms, p99 115ms under 512-token average.
- rwd-m-13b-fp16 (higher quality, higher cost): 720 TPS, median token latency 28ms, p95 140ms, p99 260ms — likely misses p99 SLA at current cluster size without additional capacity.
- rwd-s-7b-opt (balanced): 1.2k TPS, median token latency 16ms, p95 88ms, p99 150ms.

Links: https://redwood-inference.share/verified-profiles/20280520/cerebro (full perf snapshots)
Drive eval pack: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCerebro-eval-pack
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/654321

Next steps: Can you share the 500-record labeled tranche by Wednesday so Aditya and I can run the short sweep? I’ll draft the pilot plan/commit once we see the sweep.

Thanks,
Rafael

Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo recap + model-fit evidence (need quick sweep)

Quick results from micro-run (using their prompt patterns):
- Repro provisioning for rwd-m-3b-quant snapshot: 4x A100 (40GB) per pool node, continuous batching enabled, effective batch size 96, avg sequence length 420 tokens.
- Measured (10k tokens total, warm cache): median token latency 11.6ms, p95 66ms, p99 112ms. End-to-end single-request p99 (including routing/overhead) ~125ms when routed through US-west region.
- Throughput: ~1.7k TPS aggregate (batched) on a 4-node pool; linear up to ~3.8k TPS before kernel contention increases p99.

Recommendation on hallucination detection: start with Redwood’s built-in low-confidence detector (cheap, integrated with runtime) + a lightweight reranker for any high-value candidates. Reranker only needed when recall has to be aggressively preserved and false-positives are costly.

I added a short CSV with token-latency buckets to the Drive folder (perf_micro_20280522.csv).

-Aditya

Subject: Consolidated: perf details + next steps (pilot + timeline)

Lisa / Tom — consolidated update and next steps below. Thanks to Aditya for the micro-run. Short summary you can forward internally: 

1) Repro details: rwd-m-3b-quant snapshot used 4x A100(40GB) nodes, batch size 96, avg seq 420. Micro-run numbers: median token 11.6ms, p95 66ms, p99 112ms (end-to-end p99 ~125ms including routing). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCerebro-eval-pack

2) Pilot plan (2 weeks):
- Week 0: dataset ingestion + guardrail integration (low-confidence detector).
- Week 1: Dedicated small pool ramp to target QPS; collect perf traces and quality metrics.
- Deliverable: perf snapshot + quality report + SLO recommendation.

3) Concerns & mitigations:
- Risk: p99 jumps under highly skewed long-tail sequences. Mitigation: token-length-aware routing and dynamic kernel selection; we’ll include a regression alert on token-length distribution shifts.
- Risk: quality regressions from quantized variants. Mitigation: we’ll run a baseline on fp16 candidate and the quantized variant and gate rollout on quality delta < 0.02 F1.

Action items:
- Cerebro to share 500 labeled records (due Wed EOD) — Rafael to confirm receipt.
- Redwood to run full sweep within 48h of receiving labels and return a pilot quote.

If that plan looks good I’ll send a short pilot SOW and a HubSpot task for sign-off.

Best,
Rafael
